name: A1 Legacy Labs

market.label: target-market
market.the: the US, UK, Canada and Australia

event_note: seen in the site code, Nov 20

enquiries.label: Scoping call requests
enquiries.how: Count of the generate_lead event the site sends when the enquiry form is sent.
caveats: The site sends generate_lead when the form is sent ({note}).
Bookings made by email or phone are not counted here.
breakdowns: Page the request was sent from
enquiries.reading: Reply to each request the same day.
enquiries.test: Send one test request after accepting cookies; it should show in Analytics Realtime within minutes.

enquiries.label: Demo opens
enquiries.how: Count of voice_widget_open and chat_widget_open, sent when a visitor opens the voice or chat demo.
caveats: The site sends both events from its demo widgets ({note}).
Opening a demo is interest, not a conversation held.
enquiries.test: Open the voice demo after accepting cookies and check voice_widget_open in Analytics Realtime.

enquiries.label: Button clicks
enquiries.how: Count of the cta_click event the site sends from its main buttons.
caveats: The site sends cta_click from its call-to-action buttons ({note}).
enquiries.test: Click a main button after accepting cookies and check cta_click in Analytics Realtime.

authority_steps: Get listed on Clutch, G2 and the GoHighLevel partner directory.
Earn one link from a US or UK small-business publication.
